name: Himeno Sena
source: The protagonist's childhood friend, who suddenly moved to another place a few years ago. She's secretly popular amongst the male students. [spoiler]Sena is that girl who Koutarou fell in love with and gave the letter to, only to have her transfer the next day and leave Koutarou unable to associate himself with anything regarding romance.[/spoiler]
